points.description: The answer conveys that the link must support two-way (full-duplex or semi-duplex) communication between sender and receiver, so acknowledgements can travel back on frames carrying data. Equivalent wording, or the alternative that frames must contain an extra acknowledgement field, also earns the mark.

rubric.notes: The model answer is a single requirement with two equivalent phrasings, so there is one point worth the full mark. Full marks go to a student who states either bidirectional (full or semi-duplex) communication or an acknowledgement field in frames. Zero marks if the student names an unrelated requirement, such as error-free channels or fixed frame size.
